content.help: Turns F4SR upscaling on or off. Applies when you close the menu.
UI Native: the game and ENB render at the Render Resolution, the UI at full resolution. Faster, sharper UI. Needs the XeSS-FG engine (FSR-FG uses Classic). Needs a restart.
FSR 4.1: best image, highest GPU cost. FSR 3.1: lightest. XeSS: runs on any GPU. Applies when you close the menu.
Lower = more FPS, softer image. Native = AA only. Applies on return to gameplay; the panel says if a restart is needed.
FSR sharpening (RCAS); 0 = off. XeSS ignores it. Keep low if ENB also sharpens.
Stops particles, fire, glass and water from smearing. Recommended on. Turning it on needs a restart.
Smoother motion, a little more latency. Needs upscaling. Classic + XeSS-FG: turning it on needs a restart.
XeSS-FG: 2X-4X, smoother pacing, required for UI Native. FSR-FG: 2X, Classic pipeline only. Needs a restart.
Pick it so real FPS x multiplier is near your refresh rate. Higher only adds latency. Applies live.
Effects go under the HUD. UI Native: with ENB, before upscaling (exact depth). Screen-fixed overlays may smear.
Gives ReShade the game's depth (AO, DOF, fog) under XeSS-FG and at reduced render sizes in Classic. Applies live.
Top-left panel: FPS, upscaler, render size, frame generation, ReShade. Switches live. Errors show it for 30 s even when off.
Writes GPU, driver, OS, display and related mods (ENB, ReShade, HighFPSPhysicsFix) at the top of f4sr.log for bug reports. No user or computer names. Applies at the next start.
Shows FidelityFX's debug view (motion vectors, reactive mask). Troubleshooting only.
Clears upscaler history every frame. If ghosting goes away, report it with f4sr.log.
Developer diagnostic: saves frame-generation sample images. May stutter. Leave off.
